comment: Shared cases of sqm.py and lua/sqm.lua (tests/test_sqm.py, tests/lua/test_sqm.lua). tc is a fake: devices maps a device to its root qdisc [kind, handle]; a missing device fails `show` (rc 1); fail_replace makes `replace` fail (no cake module); missing_tc answers rc 127 to everything. commands lists the executed argv joined by spaces.

sync.name: off by default: nothing runs, nothing is recorded
on without a rate: nothing is shaped
on: cake over the kernel default of each probed tunnel
commands: tc qdisc show dev ovpnclient2 root
tc qdisc replace dev ovpnclient2 root cake bandwidth 18000kbit besteffort triple-isolate nat
tc qdisc show dev ovpnclient2 root
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc replace dev wgclient1 root cake bandwidth 18000kbit besteffort triple-isolate nat
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: applied and recently verified: no process
applied: re-read every 300 s
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: the owner's own root qdisc is never replaced
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: a cake that is not ours is not taken over
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: our cake replaced by the owner: no longer ours, left alone
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: switched off: our cake goes back to the kernel default
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc del dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: rate changed: restored, then applied with the new rate
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc del dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc replace dev wgclient1 root cake bandwidth 9000kbit besteffort triple-isolate nat
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: tunnel restart: the new device has the kernel default, the record is dropped and cake applied again
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc replace dev wgclient1 root cake bandwidth 18000kbit besteffort triple-isolate nat
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: tunnel restart while off: nothing to restore
a tunnel not probed now keeps its record
no cake module: replace fails, nothing recorded
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc replace dev wgclient1 root cake bandwidth 18000kbit besteffort triple-isolate nat
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: no tc: failed, nothing recorded
commands: tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root

sync.name: invalid rows and records are ignored

release.name: service stop: every recorded cake back to the kernel default, other roots untouched
commands: tc qdisc show dev ovpnclient2 root
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc del dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc show dev wgclient1 root
tc qdisc show dev wgclient3 root

root_qdisc:
qdisc noqueue 0: root refcnt 2 
noqueue
qdisc fq_codel 0: root refcnt 2 limit 10240p flows 1024 quantum 1514 target 5ms interval 100ms memory_limit 4Mb ecn drop_batch 64 
fq_codel
qdisc cake 8003: root refcnt 2 bandwidth 18Mbit besteffort triple-isolate nat nowash no-ack-filter split-gso rtt 100ms raw overhead 0 
cake
qdisc mq 0: root 
qdisc fq_codel 0: parent :1 limit 10240p
mq
qdisc fq_codel 0: parent :1 limit 10240p
